h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Maheshtala

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Maheshtala

c: Maheshtala stretches along the east bank of the Hooghly on Kolkata's southern edge, a dense town of small workshops, old neighbourhoods and new apartment blocks. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Maheshtala for the municipality, schools, neighbourhood clubs and housing complexes. We make the machines at our factory in Vasai, about 1630 km away, and bring them by road.

With so little spare ground, many open gyms here go into a corner of a club field, a school yard or an apartment podium. We work from your measurements and photos to fit the machines in. The river belt is humid all year and waterlogs quickly in the monsoon. Galvanised frames resist the damp, and a raised base with good drainage keeps footings clear of standing water. Our team or a dealer in eastern India installs everything.

items.q: Can outdoor gym equipment go on a podium slab?
items.a: Often, yes, using the self-standing method on a firm, level slab. Your structural consultant should confirm the slab, and we mark each machine and its clear space on the drawing.

items.q: How do we keep machines in good shape in a humid riverside town?
items.a: Wipe the handles and moving joints every few weeks, clear standing water after rain and tighten loose bolts. Our handover routine lists the checks in order.

items.q: Who do I call for spare parts later?
items.a: Our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or aftersales@funplaysystems.com. Send the machine name and a photo, and they will arrange the part.
